location.venue: MA State House Bowdoin St Entrance

description:
You will have to pay more on Tuesday June 24th, because of the extreme heat. Whether it's an extra water bottle, higher electric bills, or even a trip to the emergency room from dehydration or worse. It doesn't end June 24th either. We will face extreme heat, wildfires, floods, and other disasters due to climate change.

We did not choose this. It was fossil fuel companies who polluted our air with greenhouse gases and who were willing to lie for decades to keep making billions of dollars in profits. They exacerbated these disasters for money. What's worse is these companies think they will get to keep all of their profits while we suffer the consequences. We're not going to let that happen.

The Climate Superfund could pay for infrastructure to prevent the T from flooding. It could pay for forest and brush management practices to prevent wildfires. The Climate Superfund will give us a chance to build Massachusetts in a way that will survive and thrive for decades to come.
